### Star Gazer — *Friendship is Magic* (G4)

**Who he is.** A recurring **Canterlot high-society Earth-pony stallion**, recognizable among the fancy gala crowds. In his debut, *The Best Night Ever* (S1E26), he attends the Grand Galloping Gala and trips over apples near Applejack’s stand.

**Appearance.** Light-gray coat, short brushed grayish-brown mane and tail, amber-gold eyes, and a **blue telescope-and-star cutie mark**. He often wears a pale-blue formal collar with a pinkish-red cravat.

**Names.** **“Star Gazer” is a fandom/wiki placeholder**, not a confirmed on-screen name. The [character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Gazer) reports that director Jayson Thiessen called him **“the Carl Sagan pony”** in the Season One DVD commentary—an informal production nickname. Gameloft’s licensed mobile game instead labels the corresponding pony **“Everypony's Favorite Guest”** ([game character listing](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Characters/D_-_K)); that is a game-specific name, **not a disguise or secret identity**.

**Speaking and appearances.** He distinctly calls **“Sweetie Belle!”** during her dream in *For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils* (S4E19); no reliable individual voice-actor credit was found. Other sightings include *Sweet and Elite*, *A Canterlot Wedding – Part 2*, *Magical Mystery Cure*, *Rarity Takes Manehattan*, *Make New Friends but Keep Discord*, and several season-nine episodes. He also appears in IDW *Micro-Series* #4.
